name: Sora Zero-to-Hero Prompting Guide 🎬
description_md:
### What You Get

- 
Comprehensive Sora Prompting Guide: A detailed breakdown of shot types, camera movements, lighting techniques, and advanced descriptors to create visually stunning AI-generated videos.

- 
Custom GPT Co-Pilot: Your personal Sora assistant that simplifies prompt creation. Start from a vague idea and refine it into perfect text-to-video prompts, step-by-step.

- 
Exemplary Prompts: Access tried-and-tested high-performing prompts (single-scene and storyboard-based) to inspire and accelerate your workflow.

- 
Technical Frameworks: From scene elements and video quality to post-production refinements, every detail is covered to help you craft cinematic, hyper-detailed outputs.
